title: Battle of Patras (1466)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Patras (1466)", at revision 1370452930, opens: "The Battle of Patras was a military engagement between the Venetian army and the Ottomans. The Ottomans emerged victorious, defeating two Venetian armies in Patras." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q119167274, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1466 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
